robust.change: Cache raw Hermite entries as before; on a cache miss query a separate persistent tmd BVH for distance and closest point instead of TriangleUtils float region classification.
robust.process_contract: Exactly one immutable mesh and one octree construction per exporter process; run with --threads 1.
robust.mutex: Cache access and raw sample creation are protected; more than one thread can still change which sample wins, and this does not repair upstream statistics races.
preserved: tricubic coefficient construction and query evaluation
raw-node sharing and zero mixed Hermite derivatives
limits: The representative gradient at a medial tie remains arbitrary.
This is not a prescribed smoothing width, a conservative SDF, or a global error guarantee.
Repeated logical nodes near a key rounding boundary can still receive different keys; use an aligned dyadic grid and check seams at the actual world-coordinate scale.
The collision guard prevents merging adjacent logical nodes only under the declared sampling lattice spacing; it cannot infer a wrong maxDepth or step.
Sharing raw Hermite inputs does not prove all adaptive coarse/fine interfaces continuous; rerun full seam checks.
Signed-distance semantics require the same closed consistently oriented mesh assumptions as tmd; this does not repair invalid geometry.
Zero-distance and medial-tie gradient representatives are not unique and do not prove global C1 continuity.
Double evaluation still queries float32-stored geometry and is not an exact arithmetic or global interpolation error certificate.
robust.coordinate_scope: World-coordinate full-map or ROI dyadic grids; actual bounds and depths are recorded by each exporter JSON, not fixed by this patch.
robust.grid_contract: Set step to the finest raw sampling lattice spacing (half the finest cell). Distinct logical sampling nodes must be at least one step apart on some axis. Same-key points differing by step/4 or more on any axis throw instead of merging.
robust.raw_value_method: tmd::TriangleMeshDistance::signed_distance on the complete immutable float32 mesh promoted to double; bypass TriangleUtils region classification and ignore the supplied nearestTriangleIndex.
robust.raw_gradient_method: For nonzero signed distance, (point-nearest_point)/signed_distance. At zero distance, the selected triangle's oriented double cross-product unit normal is the shared representative. Mixed Hermite derivatives remain zero.

robust.construction_cost: An additional CPU BVH is built once per exporter process. Upstream nearest-face queries still run; this adaptation accepts duplicate search work to isolate raw-value correctness.
